name: Light Harmonic Carrier
description: Fundamental carrier of color, phase, and harmonic information in electromagnetic fields. Responsible for visible spectrum structure, slow-light phenomena, and coherent light-matter coupling.

seeded_from.conceptual: Derived from emphasis on color and light harmonics in the 144-element expansion request, cross-referenced with existing phonon/optical axes in PT2 hypercube work.

properties.spectrum_range: UV to far-IR (primary visible band emphasis)

yin_yang_polarity: Balanced carrier of both generative (Yang) light and receptive (Yin) absorption
